record.question: Which country signed an accord to join as new member of NATO?
record.explanation: Answer C: Macedonia. NATO Allies signed the accession protocol for the future Republic of North Macedonia on 6 February 2019. Macedonia is the corresponding printed country. Signing the protocol began the final ratification process; it did not itself make the country a full member that day. Historical/source note: Protocol signed in 2019 for North Macedonia, printed as Macedonia. Full NATO membership came in 2020; do not describe it as an existing full member in April 2019. Reference: https://www.nato.int/en/news-and-events/articles/news/2019/02/06/nato-allies-sign-accession-protocol-for-the-future-republic-of-north-macedonia. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
